function: Diffusion Schrödinger-bridge model refines the least-squares estimate of the ISAC sensing (target-echo) channel into the ground-truth channel, in one inference step (p. 1-4).
system: MIMO ISAC: transmitting and receiving BS with N=32-antenna ULAs, K UEs (LoS), L=3 targets, orthogonal pilots tau_p=N+K; carrier band not stated (p. 2, 4).
method: Generative: diffusion Schrödinger bridge (VE-DSB) with time-conditioned UNet (ResBlocks, self-attention), data-prediction loss on paired LS and true channels, supervised, ODE sampling with S=1 (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own simulation: scattering sensing channel (L=3 targets, ULA steering vectors), LoS UE channels; 10,000 samples split 7,500 training and 2,500 testing; no standard channel (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training and testing (N=32, L=3, 7,500/2,500 split); NMSE evaluated for SNR from -10 to 10 dB; no unseen scenario (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, LMMSE. Learned: DnCNN, Double-CNN (ref. 3), UNet, pix2pix GAN (ref. 4), Brownian bridge diffusion (ref. 11) (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE in dB versus SNR; number of inference steps; heatmap examples; effect of training timesteps on NMSE (p. 4-5).
complexity: Inference O(N^3 + S N^2) with S=1 inference step (LS O(N^3), network O(N^2) FLOPs), against LMMSE O(N^6) and S>=100 of earlier diffusion works (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "we adopt a scattering channel model [1]" - own simulated ULA sensing channel with LoS UE channels; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "A total of 10,000 Monte Carlo samples are generated (7,500 for training, 2,500 for testing)" - held-out split of the same data plus an SNR sweep; footnote 1 (p. 2) claims good results with non-orthogonal pilots but reports none.
q3_support: p. 4: "we compare the proposed method with previous channel estimation algorithms, including LMMSE, DnCNN, Double-CNN [3], pix2pix GAN [4], and the Brownian bridge [11]" - NMSE versus SNR in Fig. 2 (LS also plotted).
q4_support: p. 4: "the overall complexity for inference is" O(N^3 + S N^2), with S = 1 step, against O(N^6) for LMMSE (Section IV-B).
q5_support: p. 4: "A total of 10,000 Monte Carlo samples are generated" - self-generated simulation data; no code or data link or DOI appears in the letter.
notes: Area 2: the learned method estimates the sensing (target-echo) channel of an ISAC system that also serves K communicating UEs (p. 2), so it is not excluded as sensing alone. K and the carrier frequency are not given in the simulation setup (p. 4). The claim of adaptation to complex channel models (p. 5) and the non-orthogonal pilot claim (p. 2) have no reported test.
